reviews.text: I’d have to rate the service of this business as poor quality. There was work done on bigger projects that was alright and if you use them for big repairs you might be okay, but I really can’t say whether or not I was priced fairly compared to other pool businesses with similar services because I didn’t get other quotes to compare, so that’d fall on me as a customer. I can’t recommend the services of this business for pool cleaning. They came out for one month once a week and the pool never got in better shape. The business attempted to remedy the issue when communicated about our lack of satisfaction, but responses were quite slow. The need for our business didn’t come across as urgent or even needed at all. Communication for taking care of issues could’ve been improved, and then after getting multiple chances the business was not able to provide the services they offered and that us as customers paid for. The algae in the pool was not ever fully cleaned each week they came. Yet, when another business came, the situation was addressed, and communication was improved significantly. The pool was much cleaner and looks like a pool service cleaning company actually comes to clean the pool, as opposed to if you use Executive Blue Pools where your pool won’t look clean and inexperienced handlers will be at your property not properly trained. That’s what I gathered and concluded, but I could be wrong. My experience is only mine and from one property. With that being said, this business did not meet any expectations of ours or do services provided with a customer satisfaction rate based on what we paid them and what they stated on their website. For these reasons, I cannot recommend using this company’s services, unless you want a pool that constantly has some form of algae in it.

reviews.text:
My pool board died on me and the owner worked with me to get it fixed. He took my feedback into account and made sure that the issue was resolved and that ultimately I was satisfied.
I recommend Executive Blue Pools for busy professionals that want their pool to work and want to know that it will be resolved when it doesn't.
reviews.author: John Knight

reviews.text: The guys coming out do an ok job, but when you need to have any other service they will always try to upsell you. To change out a $10 gasket they wanted to charge me almost $300. When I got a small leak in the bottom of our pool filter the company insisted in replacing the whole thing for a cost of $2242.60 and said the company "Jandy" no longer makes the bottom part of the filter. I found the matching bottom end of the filter from Leslie's pool supply for $589 (before tax) and asked if they would install it. They did say that if it showed up and wasn't the same filter they wouldn't be able to guarantee the work, which I was ok with. When it arrived and I was trying to get the work done this week (since it is leaking), they refused to do the work all together. Be careful when having them quote work for your pool, ALWAYS get a second opinion or just do a simple search online for the product and how to actually fix the problem. Many times I was able to easily fix the problem for a significant fraction of the cost. Do not trust what they tell you up front always confirm.
reviews.author: john bailly

reviews.text: This company prides itself on quality and reliability! I’ve never heard of another pool company that runs quality assurance checks to keep their employees accountable but that’s the dedication to precision and cleanliness the owner of this company exudes, if you believe your current pool cleaning service isn’t doing your pool justice, and you want to see just how beautiful it can be, I’d recommend calling and getting one of their service professionals to come give you a quote.
reviews.author: Chris Addington

reviews.text: This is a great company.   I've been using them for a few years to clean my filters every 6 months.   Each time the pool runs much better and cleans a lot more efficiently and effectively.   They also noticed a drain plug that was cracked and changed it promptly at minimal cost.   I plan to use this company for as long as I own a pool .
reviews.author: Robert C

reviews.text: I can’t recommend this company enough. Through the freeze and all the damage as a result, owner Brian Bellflower and his crew have remained steadfast, courteous, professional, responsive, they’ve kept the lines of communication open, and most of all our pool looks great. If you need a reliable pool service that is committed to making sure your pool is there for enjoyment and not headaches, Executive Blue Pools is the way to go.
reviews.author: David Olshansky

reviews.text:
Been with EBP for going on 8 years now. Have used them for many services over those 8 years. Owner has always been available to talk through issues that have come up. Cleaning has always been weekly unless communicated otherwise.

Services done - install much needed new filter system, repair heater from freeze damage, install and fix booster pump,  replace burned out pool lights, general system repairs, filter cleans, weekly cleaning and chemicals.

Owning a pool in general requires owner dedication and attention to detail. Coupled that with communication with EBP has ensured that a “ready to go” and “have fun pool” has been available in both summer and winter through the years. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Peter M

reviews.text: Executive Blue Pools has been servicing my pool for over four years, both weekly maintenance and repair.They are reliable and reasonable. if I have questions or concerns, Brian responds in a timely manner. I have been very happy.
reviews.author: Cindy Halderman

reviews.text: Just called Executive Blue Pools Frisco in a major crunch to get a next-day pool inspection done for a home sale- I am overwhelmed with the kindness I received for EBP with such a crazy request! They are sending someone tomorrow and my house will be able to close on time! AMAZING!! THANK YOU!!!!
reviews.author: Jessica Gonzalez

reviews.text: We've been using Executive Blue for several years now.  They have been incredibly reliable and their service techs have great attention to detail.  They've been great at forewarning us bout pending issues so we've been able to address them before they became big $$$ issues.  Can highly recommend.
reviews.author: Tupper Patnode

reviews.text: Brian and the team at Executive Blue Pools have been excellent to work with. Their team of technicians have been managing our pool for almost a year now, including weekly cleanings and periodic servicing of the equipment. Their service really went up a notch in my eyes after the winter storms of 2021. Some of our equipment was damaged, and we were without a working pool for nearly a month due to the lack of available parts in the DFW area. This was in no fault of Brian’s team, and they were very open with their communication to me throughout the entire ordeal about when parts would be available so they could come out and repair the problems. I have been more than satisfied with their work, and I trust that when Brian says something is going to be done it will be done as soon as possible.
reviews.author: Matt W

reviews.text: We contracted Executive Blue Pools to provide regular maintenance to our pool and pool spa, but after about 3 months our pool spa started generating algae. We let them know as soon as we noticed it, and they requested pictures as evidence, which we provided. We followed up with them multiple times and never received a response, but they continued sending their personnel to do the regular service. After a couple of months of not having the issue fixed, we decided to call the owner to cancel our services. He was very defensive and began making unvalid excuses to try to justify the situation. It's ironic that we contracted a pool company to keep our pool clean and healthy and under their care it generates algae, which was not there when they began servicing our pool. I will not recommend this company and hope nobody else has the same experience than us.
reviews.author: Jessica Galarza

reviews.text: Adore their customer service. Everyone that I've spoken with has been excellent with communication and explanations. I've only had fantastic experiences with this company. Reliability and honesty go a long way.
reviews.author: Alexis Clinton

reviews.text:
We've used Executive Blue for the past 3 years with nothing but great results.  Our pool is always in great shape, and the weekly maintenance team is very thorough.

Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Stephen Vance

reviews.text: Had a very loud pump! Brian and his team came out and diagnosed the problem. He was very informative on what I should do. The pump was very old and his team replaced the pump with a quiet more efficient pump. Very pleased with the service!
reviews.author: Cody Barnes

reviews.text: Executive Blue Pools took care of my pool for many years and they were always honest and dependable and easy to work with.  I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Mike Williamson

reviews.text: The response to this review from the company’s owners is a blatant lie. I spoke with the owner several times and each time he told me that he would not know if our pool had black algae until they started to clean it, but if it did that he would need to charge us more to treat it. At no point did the owner tell us that the company did not treat black algae, only that it would cost extra. Then after I went ahead and signed with them, have them my payment information and agreed to any extra costs and visits the owner called me and said they actually don’t treat black algae, but assured us that he would be happy to clean our pool once we got the Algae taken care of ourselves. It was very clear that he didn’t want to do the extra work of the initial deep clean and just wanted to guarantee another weekly customer.This owner is lazy and unprofessional.
reviews.author: Haley Parks

reviews.text: Great customer service and meticulous weekly cleaning. Also, we had an issue with rabbits biting through our pool equipment wires and Executive Blue went above and beyond to help us fix the problem.
reviews.author: Brian Reardon

reviews.text: Please be smart and stay away. We used them for weekly service and equipment service for a few months. Every time they came the tech would call Brian who would tell me something needed to be replaced. Only to find out now they had actually done quite a bit of damage to our equipment and then were trying to charge us to repair.
reviews.author: Arielle Brodsky

reviews.text: This review is for Suzy Bass, she doesn't know how to leave reviews.  So she called and said Brian and Staff did an outstanding job, in fact she called no less than 10 pool companies with help whatsoever.  Brian came to the rescue and has her pool up and running in tip top shape.  Suzy Bass thanks Executive Blue Pools from the bottom of her heart!!!
reviews.author: Joe Yetzer

reviews.text:
We have been using them for some time now and their service is very good.  Their techs spend a good amount of time weekly and do a great job of explaining any issues.

Brian has been great to deal with and is very fair with all business dealings.
reviews.author: Marie Rulon

reviews.text:
Lack of knowledgeable/experienced service people.  Constant requests for repairs without detail.  Most importantly, pool not maintained well.  Overall, poor quality of service, communication and management.  Just my experience of course, but recommend you look elsewhere for your pool service needs.

UPDATE: My review isn’t bogus. Not sure how the owner could imply as much given information provided. Their lack of knowledge is similar to their lack of service. I was a customer that was transitioned to Executive Blue Pools from Mikes Sparkling Pools. Word of advice to Executive Blue, focus on providing better service to generate more positive reviews instead of trying to instill doubt in legitimate poor reviews.
reviews.author: T D

reviews.text: Great communication and quality service! I never thought I’d say that about a pool company, but Brian and his team deliver. I needed a new pump installed, but decided to go ahead and replace the entire aging equipment set. Brian worked me into his schedule immediately and I couldn’t be happier with the speed and quality of the work, the new equipment, or the price. I fired my old pool service and now use Executive Blue Pools for my weekly cleaning service as well. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: J B

reviews.text: It's a small business, so it's nice that the business owner knows you personally. They're very good at letting you know what routine upkeep is needed or if parts need to be replaced and working up quotes. Have used them for many years!
reviews.author: Laura Gardner

reviews.text: We have used Executive Pool for several years for weekly pool cleaning and pool repairs.  They are professional and never miss a pool cleaning.   Repairs are made very fast so our pool is rarely out of service.  Easy to reach the owner with any questions.  I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Amy Childress

reviews.text: Brian Bellflower is customer centered and very responsive to any questions or concerns. It's a small business so you are able to interact directly with the owner. That is very helpful for a first time pool owner. I highly recommend Executive Blue Pools.
reviews.author: Victor Terry

reviews.text: Brian and his crew are very professional and friendly. They do a very good job on the weekly servicing of the pool. And are very prompt to respond for any issues/concerns with the water quality or when equipment needs repaired.
reviews.author: Ray Meyers

reviews.text: What impressed me the most was their commitment to customer satisfaction. They were responsive to my questions and concerns, addressing them promptly and effectively. The staff is friendly, courteous, and genuinely cares about providing top-notch service. Thank you
reviews.author: Raunak Noorani

reviews.text: Overpriced for what they do, quoted nearly 1000 dollars for somehing I went out and accomplished by resetting the device. Paid 3 grand in one month for two filters and service. They are quite rude and demeaning when you don't know what they are talking about. Threatened to drop us because we didn't do something that's wasn't explained to us, we asked and just got a belittling look.
reviews.author: Ambass

reviews.text: Executive has been maintaining my pool for years. Just installed a heater and Brian and team walked me through the whole process. They had it installed in one day and it's working great! I would recommend them 100%
reviews.author: Jim Shankle

reviews.text: Save yourself time finding a new pool guy later because you will fire Brian eventually so just bypass this company upfront.  Average pricing, average weekly service at best; always trying to upsell unnecessary and expensive service and repairs and when we complain about the pool service he had the gall to say "I don't make enough money on your pool to work on it."  Still waiting for our refund for the remainder of the month.
reviews.author: Lennie Nicholson

reviews.text: Executive Blue Pools has been our pool service choice for a long time.  Recently, they have gone above and beyond and deserve more than a 5 star.  On the day of a scheduled party, a flower pot found its way into the pool with disastrous results.  Executive Blue responded to our 911 making moves in their schedule to help us in a time of need.
reviews.author: Curtis King

reviews.text: What an amazing company to work with! They treat my family like their family. Not only do they go above and beyond to make sure my needs are met, they educate me on how to keep my pool at its best all year long. Brian is a great owner; very genuine, honest and upfront! Thank you for your partnership!!
reviews.author: Misty Vaughan

reviews.text: Save yourself the time and headache of dealing with Brian.  I decided after a resurface that I would give a pool service a try with my pool.  I picked the wrong company to trust.  I had constant issues with algae, poor chemistry, and excuses.  He even went so far as to claim my pool "had a history of algae problems".  Yeah it sure did the month Executive Blue Pools took over responsibility.  The set-up is there for a great operation, the owner or management just doesn't allow it.  The emailed reports were nice to know they had been there.  The poorly trained staff that were replaced multiple times during the few months I had their service were not.
reviews.author: Jonathan Cave

reviews.text: Executive GREEN pools is more like it. Horrible, unreliable service. I don’t know what their workers do when they’d come to my house, but it wasn’t much. For the second time, my pool is full of algae, and it’s because there is no chlorine in it. Brian tried to tell me that I wasn’t running my pool enough, which is odd, because it was running 22 hours per day. I finally checked the chlorinator (tube that holds hockey puck-type chlorine tabs), and there was no chlorine in it.   Tested the water, and there was no chlorine detected.  Contacted Brian multiple times to get someone over to at least put chlorine in, and I can see that he’s reading my messages, but no response. Won’t answer phone. I canceled my service.
reviews.author: Paul Key (YouTubeCensorsMe)

reviews.text: The team is very reliable and hard workers! Brian and his team respond quickly and do a great job! Love smaller companies because they are more personable and make you feel like you are number 1!
reviews.author: Lyndi DeWald
